origin: SEG source inventory with final approved maturity classification. Every entry was verified against a file present in this repository; counts are exact line/record/chapter totals. mappingDepth full allows chapter/unit mapping; partial restricts mapping to available layers only — missing chapters or summaries are never created. No content is mapped here.

sources.name: ROSH Review EM Initial Certification 2026
sources.notes: Four supplied source files merged while preserving all 2,728 records from the previous two-file bank unchanged. The third and fourth files added 1,000 and 1,297 non-overlapping questions. The second file had 718 stems identical to the first with matching answers and options, so they were not added twice. Twenty distinct chapters and 5,025 preserved records; 3,994 are practice eligible. 242 later duplicate stems and 853 records referencing absent visual/audio media are flagged (1,031 unique withheld records). No topicId assignment; medical content remains under review.
